## Pyramid of Pain

| Level | Pain to adversary | Items | Response |
|---|---|---|---|
| TTPs | Tough | T1071.001 Web Protocols | Detect the behaviour; the adversary must change how they operate. |
| Tools | Challenging | ExampleLoader, rclone | Detect the tool's artefacts; the adversary must retool. |
| Network and host artefacts | Annoying | hxxps[:]//login[.]example[.]com/c2 | Detect URL paths, user agents and similar artefacts. |
| Domain names | Simple | c2[.]example[.]net, cdn[.]example[.]net, mail[.]example[.]net, drop[.]example[.]org | Block and sinkhole; cheap for the adversary to replace. |
| IP addresses | Easy | 192[.]0[.]2[.]44, 2001:db8::44, 198[.]51[.]100[.]5 | Block at the edge for a short period. |
| Hash values | Trivial | aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa | Block in EDR; any change to the file defeats it. |
